CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_wage_order(p_authority wage_authority, p_letter_no character varying, p_letter_date date, p_effective_from date, p_rates jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- 1. Update the previous latest order for this authority
    -- Set its valid_to to one day before the new effective date
    UPDATE wage_orders
    SET valid_to = p_effective_from - INTERVAL '1 day'
    WHERE authority = p_authority
      AND valid_to = '9999-12-31'; -- Only close the currently active one

    -- 2. Insert the new order
    INSERT INTO wage_orders (authority, letter_no, letter_date, valid_from, valid_to, rates)
    VALUES (p_authority, p_letter_no, p_letter_date, p_effective_from, '9999-12-31', p_rates);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_employee_wage_dashboard(p_agreement_id integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id integer, full_name character varying, designation character varying, first_wage_date date, last_wage_date date, pending_from date, pending_to date, current_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.full_name,
        e.designation,
        (SELECT MIN(transaction_date) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0) as first_wage,
        (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0) as last_wage,

        -- Pending From: Day after last wage, or Joining Date if no wages yet
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0),
            e.joining_date
        )::DATE as p_from,

        -- Pending To: Last day of previous month
        (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as p_to,

        -- Balance: Total CR - Total DR
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cr_amount) - SUM(dr_amount) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id), 0) as balance

    FROM employees e
    WHERE e.agreement_id = p_agreement_id
    ORDER BY e.is_reliever ASC, e.designation ASC, e.full_name ASC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_wage_summary_report(p_agreement_id integer, p_due_from date, p_due_to date, p_drawn_on date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id integer, full_name character varying, due numeric, drawn numeric, balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            e.id,
            e.full_name,
            -- Calculate Due amount for the specified period
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.cr_amount), 0)
             FROM wages_ledger wl
             WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date BETWEEN p_due_from AND p_due_to) as due_calc,

            -- Calculate Drawn amount up to the specified date
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.dr_amount), 0)
             FROM wages_ledger wl
             WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date <= p_drawn_on) as drawn_calc,

            -- Calculate Balance
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.cr_amount), 0) FROM wages_ledger wl WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date BETWEEN p_due_from AND p_due_to) -
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.dr_amount), 0) FROM wages_ledger wl WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date <= p_drawn_on) as balance_calc
        FROM employees e
        WHERE e.agreement_id = p_agreement_id
        GROUP BY e.id, e.full_name
        ORDER BY e.full_name;
END;
$function$
